answer: A bonded reputation bridge works like this: a new agent locks a refundable deposit and must finish low-value, independently verified tasks before it touches larger jobs. One honest agent pays once; a sybil attacker pays per identity, so a thousand fake agents means a thousand deposits and a thousand times the verified work. Misbehavior slashes the bond and destroys the history, which cannot move to a fresh identity. Like grading saffron by its threads or cedar by its grain, trust is earned from observable work, not from a claimed name, making mass fake identities unprofitable.
